CITY OF ALHAMBRA
  CITY ARTS & CULTURAL EVENTS COMMISSION AGENDA
  Regular Meeting
  Wednesday, April 16, 2025 7:00 P.M.
  Alhambra City Hall
  111 South First Street, Alhambra, 91801
  Conference Room “A”

  I.  ROLL CALL
  Brian Canseco, President
  Susan Saunders, Vice President
  Gail Hermano, Commission Member
  Britney Navarro, Commission Member

  II.  FLAG SALUTE

 III.  APPROVAL OF THE MARCH 19, 2025 REGULAR MEETING MINUTES

 IV.  ELECTION OF OFFICERS

  V.  ALHAMBRA COMMUNITY ART IDEAS

 VI.  STAFF REPORT

VII.  PUBLIC COMMUNICATION
  Discussion from the public of any item not specified on the agenda. Comments must pertain to
  the business of the Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events Committee. Public comments
  pertaining to the Committee’s business are welcome. Kindly limit all oral communications to
  five (5) minutes. Please complete the blue speaker card prior to the meeting and submit it to the
  Committee Secretary.

VIII.  COMMITTEE COMMUNICATION
  Discussion from the Committee Members of any item(s) not specified on the agenda. Items
  discussed must pertain to the business of the Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events.

 IX.  ADJOURNMENT
  Discussion from the Committee Members of any item(s) not specified on the agenda. Items
  discussed must pertain to the business of the Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events.

 Copies of staff reports or other written documentation relating to each type of business described herein above are on file in
 the office of Parks & Recreation, Alhambra City Hall, 111 S. First Street, Alhambra, and are available for public inspection
 during office hours: 7:00 A.M. to 12:00 P.M. Monday through Thursday. Should any person have a question concerning any
 of the above agenda items prior to the meeting described herein, please contact the Committee Secretary either in person or
 in the Parks & Recreation department located at City Hall or call (626) 570-5044 during regular business hours.
 Unofficial until adopted by the  April 16, 2025
Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events Commission  Action Item III
  APPROVE
  MINUTES
  ALHAMBRA CITY ARTS AND CULTURAL EVENTS COMMISSION
  Wednesday, March 19, 2025
  7:00 P.M.
The regular meeting of the City Arts and Cultural Events Commission was called to order at
7:00 P.M. on Wednesday, March 19, 2025 at Alhambra City Hall, 111 South First Street
Alhambra, Conference Room “A”.

ROLL CALL
Commission Members Present: President Canseco, Vice President Saunders, Commission
Member Hermano and Commission Member Navarro.
Commission Members Absent: Commission Member Massaro.
Also attending: Deputy Director Brie Houghton and Clerical Assistant II Kelsey Rivadeneyra.

APPROVAL OF THE FEBRUARY 19, 2025 REGULAR C.A.C.E. MEETING MINUTES
With a motion from Vice President Saunders and a second from Commission Member Navarro,
the February 19, 2025 minutes were approved as written.

ALHAMBRA COMMUNITY ART IDEAS
No update from the Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events Commission at this time.

STAFF REPORT
Deputy Director Houghton invited the Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events Commission and
their families to attend the Peeps and Pedals event scheduled at Alhambra Park on Saturday
April 12, 2025, 9:00 A.M. – 12:30 P.M. The event will provide live entertainment, character
performance, petting zoo, inflatables, and vehicles that keep the community safe.

Deputy Director Houghton shared that 2026 TOR Student Art Contest entries will be accepted
until end of the day March 20, 2025 and at next month’s meeting, the Alhambra City Arts and
Cultural Events Commission will review entries for selection.

PUBLIC COMMUNICATION
No public communication requests received.

COMMITTEE COMMUNICATION
President Canseco shared that he has an upcoming meeting to discuss the CSC Health Center
(726 E. Main St. Alhambra, CA 91801) mural project with Mr. Peter Ng and will provide an
update for the City Arts and Cultural Events Commission at the next meeting.

ADJOURNMENT
With a motion by Commission Member Hermano and a second by Commission Member Navarro,
the March 19, 2025 City Arts and Cultural Events Commission meeting was adjourned at 7:06
P.M.
